snippet: Former South Carolina Governor Nikki Haley ruled out a 2028 presidential run, even as she criticized the Trump administration for November’s midterm rout that handed Democrats decisive congressional majorities.

title: 'Completely Misguided' to Blame Israel for Midterm Losses, Says Nikki Haley
snippet: Former US Ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley said that Vice President JD Vance is 'completely misguided' to say that the United States' relationship with Israel is one of the reasons that Republicans faced bruising losses in the midterm elections. Haley, who also served as the Governor of South Carolina, said that the midterm losses were more due to Republicans losing than Democrats winning and that voters are looking for change from the Republican party. (Source: Bloomberg)
